A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] was a '''musician''' on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After his [[Hovervan/Legends|hovervan]], and all of his equipment was stolen, he became homeless. After [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] and his band went the same way, he told that the [[Jawa]]s did it.<ref name="Stop That Jawa!" />
